$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
Set-Location $repo
git fetch origin --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'fetch failed' }

$active=@()
foreach($line in @(git worktree list --porcelain)){
  if($line -like 'branch refs/heads/*'){ $active += $line.Substring(18) }
}

$canonicalized=@(
 'agent/agent-control-federation-heartbeat-20260929',
 'agent/archive-streaming-budget-20260928',
 'agent/game-profile-id-containment-20260928',
 'agent/game-profile-id-containment-v2-20260928',
 'agent/game-profile-id-containment-v8.8.5-reconcile',
 'agent/launch-observation-atomicity-20260928',
 'agent/liveness-scheduler-machine-policy-20260929',
 'agent/programmer-updater-rest-handoff-20260928',
 'agent/reconciliation-continuity-20260929-0542-github',
 'agent/reconciliation-continuity-20260929-final-github',
 'agent/reconciliation-continuity-20260929-r3',
 'agent/replacefilew-failure-characterization-20260927',
 'agent/replacefilew-failure-characterization-v2',
 'agent/support-archive-streaming-failure-cleanup-audit-20260928',
 'agent/support-bundle-share-safety-20260928',
 'agent/support-pr-disposition-ledger-20260928',
 'agent/support-updater-lr003-native-replacement-20260928',
 'agent/support-updater-packaging-audit-20260928',
 'agent/support-updater-unowned-collision-20260928',
 'agent/support-updater-wpf-integration-audit-20260928',
 'agent/swarm-contract-v3-20260929-0540',
 'agent/updater-cross-session-ownership-20260929',
 'agent/updater-existing-release-rest-ref-20260928',
 'agent/updater-existing-release-rest-ref-gate-20260928',
 'agent/updater-existing-release-rest-ref-gate2-20260928',
 'agent/updater-installed-e2e-20260929-manager',
 'agent/windows-live-containment-hardening',
 'agent/windows-live-containment-hardening-v2',
 'feature/agent-control-panel-20260928',
 'feature/agent-control-plane-v2-20260928',
 'fix/release-classifier-workflow-scope-20260929',
 'integration/v8.8.6-release-convergence-r2-20260929',
 'ui/frontend-responsive-polish-20260928',
 'ui/frontend-ux-overhaul'
)

$deleted=@(); $skipped=@()
foreach($b in $canonicalized){
  git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/remotes/origin/$b"
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ continue }
  if($b -in $active){ $skipped += [ordered]@{branch=$b;reason='active-worktree'}; continue }
  git push origin --delete $b
  if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){ $deleted += $b } else { $skipped += [ordered]@{branch=$b;reason='delete-failed'} }
}
git fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
[ordered]@{
  main=(git rev-parse origin/main)
  deleted=$deleted
  skipped=$skipped
  active_worktrees=$active
  remaining=@(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/remotes/origin | Where-Object { $_ -ne 'origin/HEAD' })
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
